change: Profile availability (skills page capability statuses) no longer checks only five executables on PATH. available(root) also counts configured watoom_specialists (3d.inspect -> vision-3d-adapter, 3d.generate -> procedural-adapter, any entry -> specialist-adapter) and deployment-declared routes in config/watoom-routes.json restricted to known dependency names. So specialist-registry, vision-3d-inspector and procedural-generators show READY via the local-toolkit specialist, and unreal and avian show READY via the game-worker unreal-export route and the toolkit Avian generator declared in IaC.
routesFile: {{ watoom_code_root }}/config/watoom-routes.json installed by coordinator_guard.yml from watoom_code_declared_routes (unreal-editor, avian-approved-compatible-runtime, blender)

checks.unitTests: core watoom-profiles 4/4 (new case: specialists + declared routes -> READY, unknown route ignored, missing config root -> no specialist-adapter)
